headline: NatWest has brought in Adclear AI agents for marketing compliance, with approval times cut by 80%
body: NatWest has brought in AI agents from Adclear to overhaul how compliance is embedded across its marketing and communications operations, Finextra reports, slashing approval times by 80%.
note: Marketing sign-off is a routine compliance queue, the kind of back-office work banks are starting to hand to agents.
